method: All original instructions of ambient controller0053acf0, geometry00430960, conversion0056133c and RNG00562348 execute in Unicorn; C composes both restored controllers, real RNG and explicit local x87 expression/conversion. Compare ordered RNG/coordinate/sound calls, request/state bytes and guards, source immutability, return values, x87 sentinel/control word/status, stack and saved registers.
limitations: Physical sound manager0055f0e8 is a controlled endpoint; exact receiver/request descriptor/order and callback mutations are compared, without audio output or codecs.

Coordinate geometry requires nonzero positive divisors and mapped231-column lookup indices. Sound-table categories/counts and selected records are bounded to mapped test storage; malformed pointers and native divide traps are excluded.

Unicorn2.1.4 does not reproduce the x87 precision exception status bit for inexact division/conversion. That status bit is excluded. For zero-width stress cases, invalid-operation status is also excluded because Unicorn omits it for FISTP infinity; numeric output, divide-by-zero status, control word and x87 stack are still compared. Nonzero widths retain the invalid-operation comparison.
Controller ambient return is void; incidental caller-saved EAX forwarding is not treated as a semantic result.
Direct conversion cases execute the original expression and ftol then the original ratio-pop instruction, without executing unrelated controller stores.
